pi_lock.name: pi_lock
pi_lock.note: defaults: MAP from the hand-off code, PI at 0.7 of the peak (red side)

bias_dither.name: bias_dither
bias_dither.note: defaults (bias 1.8 V); bias owned by the controller

feedforward_pi.name: feedforward_pi
feedforward_pi.note: defaults: PiLock + die-sensor feed-forward from nominal knowledge

midranging.name: midranging
midranging.note: defaults: bias inner loop, heater re-centring

ramp_acquire.name: ramp_acquire
ramp_acquire.note: defaults: every ring ramps up from w = 0 and locks on the first line found

bitstat_lock.name: bitstat_lock
bitstat_lock.note: defaults: ramp acquisition, then the bit-statistics ratio lock

wdm_supervisor.name: wdm_supervisor
wdm_supervisor.note: defaults (policy cyclic): map, assign, acquire, track; tx.assignment

kalman_lqg.name: kalman_lqg
kalman_lqg.note: defaults: start warm (lock at once), target oma_opt from the nominal model

composite.name: composite
composite.note: CompositeController with one child, pi_lock at 100 kHz (exercises the composite path)
